no_such_ref.stderr: fatal: ambiguous argument 'nosuchref': unknown revision or path not in the working tree.
no_such_ref.note: `git rev-parse <ref>` (the tree reader's resolve): no `--verify` and no `--`, so git reports the rev-vs-pathspec ambiguity
what `git log -n 51 <ref> --` prints: the `--` settles the ambiguity, so git never reaches the `ambiguous argument` wording
`git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/<absent>`: `--verify` reports the arity failure and never names the rev; emitted for an empty repo, a never-pushed default branch, and a deleted branch alike
